purpose: Teach: 胴/天地/断層/母語/鉱業/私生活/積雪/雌

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の胴体損傷を、警察、鑑識されますね
lines.en: So the police do conduct forensic examinations of victim trauma in cases like this, don't they?
lines.style: Curious, almost pedagogical tone. Careful articulation. Leaning into the question as if testing knowledge rather than asking. Measured pace, no pressure.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、天地が逆さの転落事故も扱います
lines.en: Yes—we handle everything from standard falls to inverted impact scenarios. It's all part of the investigation.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, professional baseline. Straightforward delivery. Neither defensive nor elaborate. The tone of someone who's explained this before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、地震断層付近の事件を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: So cases involving seismic zones and fault lines—that falls under police jurisdiction too, I imagine?
lines.style: Gentle question-phrasing. Thoughtful pause before 'jurisdiction.' Respect in the delivery, like he's confirming rather than challenging.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の母語特定もされますね
lines.en: We do. And that includes identifying a suspect's native language when it's relevant to the case.
lines.style: Cooperative, almost warmly confirmatory. Light nod in the voice. Responsive to his curiosity rather than reciting procedure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、鉱業関連の労災を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: Work-related accidents in mining operations—those come under police investigation as well, right?
lines.style: Tentative, respectful phrasing. Slightly rising inflection on 'right,' genuinely curious. Not challenging—genuinely wondering what falls into their scope.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、芸能人の私生活ストーカー事案も担当します
lines.en: Yes. We also investigate cases involving celebrities, privacy violations, stalking—the full range.
lines.style: Professional and comprehensive. Even tempo. Matter-of-fact acknowledgment that these cases exist and are handled routinely.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、豪雪地帯の積雪事故を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: And accidental deaths in heavy snow zones—the police handle those investigations too, I assume?
lines.style: Gentle confirmation-seeking. Quieter than his previous questions, like he's learning as he goes. Respectful but engaged.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪組織の雌、つまり女性メンバーも調査されますね
lines.en: We do. We investigate organized crime thoroughly, including the roles and activities of female members within those organizations.
lines.style: Direct, measured, warm. No euphemism but no harshness either. The tone of someone comfortable with complicated realities and speaking plainly about them.
